messages:
Ana: Heads up — Nimbus Labs pinged us about co-hosting a quantized 13B model as an AWS Marketplace downloadable SKU plus an SI-managed hosted offering. They want a joint announcement and redistribution terms. Key asks: downloadable weights license, redistribution to SI partners, KMS usage for private bundles, and co-branded launch window. cc @Mike @Lucy @Sam :eyes:

Mike (Legal): Thanks Ana. Quick flags: (1) license type — permissive open or limited redistribution? (2) export control / EAR risk for quantized weights. (3) indemnity & liability caps for SI resellers. Can they share a proposed contract or redlines?

Ana: They uploaded a short deck and a sample addendum. Main ask from Nimbus: allow redistribution to certified SIs and AWS Marketplace downloadable listing.

legal-bot: New file uploaded: Nimbus_SKU_Addendum_v1.pdf — legal review requested by @Mike :white_check_mark:

Mike (Legal): Skimming addendum — their clause reads: "reseller redistribution allowed for certified partners; credit + attribution required; no further sub-licensing." Need explicit export-control clause and model provenance/weights signing. Also request a sample SLA for hosted SI offering.

Lucy (Solutions): For the SI-managed hosted offering: need deployment artifact spec. Do they expect: (a) downloadable tarball of quantized weights (b) container image for inference (c) S3-hosted model + manifest for compatible runtime? Also clarify whether SIs get host-level access or just API wrapper.

Raj (Eng): Tech notes: Nimbus provides weights in q4 and q8 formats. We should define canonical naming and checksums. Recommend: manifest.json, weights/*.bin, runtime/container.sha256. Require signed manifest and optional attest file. Example manifest snippet: {"model_name":"nimbus-13b-q8","formats":["q4","q8"],"sha256":"<hash>","quantization_notes":"f32->q4 static range","kms_encrypted":"false"}

Raj (Eng): If they want KMS-protected bundles for private/on-prem, we need an envelope key handshake + docs. That increases ops complexity for SI installs.

Sam (Product): Announcement plan — propose dual-path launch: (1) AWS Marketplace downloadable SKU (clear license + instructions), (2) Joint SI-hosted offering ~2 weeks later after SI integration validation. Lock embargo dates and asset list (blog, marketplace banner, joint press release). :calendar:

Ana: Nimbus asked for co-marketing and a joint webinar with 3-week lead time. Need legal signoff by EOD Friday to meet that.

Mike (Legal): Action items: (a) confirm license (we can propose Apache 2.0 + attribution + export control exhibit OR a limited commercial redistribution addendum), (b) draft redistribution addendum allowing certified SI redistribution with controls, (c) include indemnity language limited to gross negligence. I'll draft redline by tomorrow morning.

Lucy (Solutions): Ops action items: define packaging spec (manifest + signed weights + optional container), SI onboarding checklist (certification steps, support contact, escalation flow). I'll draft checklist by EOD Thursday.

Raj (Eng): I'll produce a validation script to verify manifest/sha256 and a sample KMS envelope flow for private bundles. ETA: 3 working days.

Sam (Product): Marketing action items: draft launch timeline + assets list. Need final license text before writing marketplace listing copy.

Ana: Decision point: permissive (Apache 2.0 + attribution) = faster/broader redistribution; limited commercial addendum = tighter SI certification and reseller controls. Thoughts?

Mike (Legal): Leaning limited addendum for now to protect us and Nimbus, with option to reclassify if Nimbus proves provenance & compliance.

Lucy (Solutions): Limited addendum works; ops will add certification gates.

Raj (Eng): Also require signed manifest verification as a precondition for SI certification.

Ana: Scheduling quick sync Fri 10am PT to review Mike's redline and ops checklist. Nimbus is OK with that window.

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: I'll block time and start an asset tracker.

Ana: Thanks team — tracking in partnership board. Uploading links to deck & addendum in the board now.
